GenAiFunction.description: Query the care network: list doctors and sites by city and/or specialty. Use for "find a medical oncologist in Hyderabad", "GYN oncology in Chennai", "surgical oncologists in Bengaluru", or "do you have X in [city]". Returns human-readable lines (provider, facility, specialty). Do not use for booking or canceling; use after the user names a city or specialty. If the user only needs a list of hospital sites by name, use HC_Get_Facilities_Chat (structured facilityListUi for Enhanced Chat).
